title: Register for the Sept 17 Webinar on Remediated Metalloprotein Data in the PDB
content: Want to use the PDB to learn more about metalloproteins? Recent wwPDB updates serve the community with improved accuracy along with brand-new annotations specific to metalloproteins, including coordination geometry annotations. Join Drs. Alison Biester and Chenghua Shao for Metalloproteins in the PDB: Understanding the remediated data on Thursday, September 17, 2026 1-2pm Eastern | 10-11am Pacific. Please register for this free event. An institutional email address for registration is preferred. You will receive confirmation and a Zoom link by email before the event. RCSB PDB Core Operations are funded by the U.S. National Science Foundation (DBI-2321666), the US Department of Energy (DE-SC0019749), and the National Cancer Institute , National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases , and National Institute of General Medical Sciences of the National Institutes of Health under grant R01GM157729. RCSB PDB uses resources of the National Energy Research Scientific Computing Center ( NERSC ), a Department of Energy User Facility.
